sites: CSU Veterinary Health System, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, CO
eligibility: Confirmed biopsiable canine STS, at least 11 kg, adequate bloodwork, no anticancer treatment in previous 2 weeks, no prior immunotherapy, no uncontrolled immune disease, all CSU visits.
intervention: Autologous engineered IV CAR-T after oral conditioning; may receive oral immunotherapy. Surgery or repeat biopsy about 1 week later.
funding: Up to $3,200 study treatment; $2,000 toward surgery or other treatment; oral immunotherapy except dispensing; up to $500 treatment-related side effects. Initial exam/diagnostic testing and remaining surgery owner-paid; screening assistance available.
deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; 6–8 weeks participation.
identity_decision: Institutional named protocol 5269 is STS only. General Flint master and older listing include osteosarcoma but no OSA cohort may be inferred here.

eligibility: Canine limb OSA removed surgically, metastases limited to lungs and visible on chest x-rays, at least 20 kg, adequate bloodwork, no chemo in past 2–3 weeks or current steroids/immunomodulators.
intervention: Autologous engineered IV CAR-T after two days conditioning chemotherapy; daily oral meds and rechecks days 1, 3, 7, 14, 28 and 60.
funding: Owner pays initial exam/diagnostics and study visit exam fees; study pays other study-related treatment, diagnostics and labs, up to $2,000 for protocol side effects; screening assistance possible.
deadline: No published recruitment end; approximately 60-day participation.
identity_decision: IACUC 3398 independent from CSU STS 5269 and Penn metastatic CAR-iNKT cutoff.
